findings.title: Silence action is displayed but cannot open its drawer
findings.body: This passes only `promRule` to `RuleActionsButtons`, so `rule` is undefined for rules rendered in the new list. The menu can still enable Silence using the Prometheus rule abilities, but `RuleActionsButtons` renders `SilenceGrafanaRuleDrawer` only when `rulerRuleType.grafana.alertingRule(rule)` is true. Consequently, users can click the visible Silence notifications item and nothing happens.
